# Exhibit Graphic Sign (EGS) — Complete Technical Knowledge Base & Entity Specifications

## Entity Profile
- **Legal & Operating Entity:** Exhibit Graphic Sign (EGS)
- **Year Established:** 2010
- **Location & Facilities:** Main in-house design studio and heavy fabrication workshops situated in Al Qusais Industrial Area, Dubai and Sharjah, United Arab Emirates.
- **Operating Radius:** UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain), Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam), and wider GCC trade hubs.
- **Corporate Website:** https://www.exhibitgraphicsign.com/

## 1. Custom Exhibition Stand Design, Fabrication & Contractor Services

### Operating Model
EGS operates as a direct production house with in-house carpentry, CNC routing, steel welding, spray painting, acrylic thermoforming, and large-format UV printing. This direct model eliminates broker markups, guarantees joinery tolerances, and enables agile overnight adjustments during on-site venue build windows.

### Primary Venues Serviced
- **Dubai World Trade Centre (DWTC):** Sheikh Saeed Halls, Za'abeel Halls, Trade Centre Arena, Al Multaqua Ballroom.
- **Dubai Exhibition Centre (DEC) / Expo City Dubai.**
- **Abu Dhabi National Exhibition Centre (ADNEC):** Halls 1 through 12, Marina Hall, ICC.
- **Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center (RICEC) & Riyadh Front Exhibition & Conference Center (RFECC), Saudi Arabia.**

### Exhibition Stand Capabilities
- **Custom Wooden Joinery:** High-density MDF, commercial plywood framing, high-pressure laminate (HPL) finishes, satin and high-gloss polyurethane spray finishes.
- **Structural Double-Decker Pavilions:** Certified structural steel frameworks with stamped engineering calculations from approved UAE structural consultants and Civil Defence compliance.
- **Audio-Visual & Lighting Integration:** Seamless high-resolution 2.6mm/3.9mm LED video walls, interactive touchscreen kiosks, recessed spotlighting, LED halo illumination, and broadcast-quality color wash lighting.
- **Venue Regulatory Handling:** Turnkey submission of architectural CAD elevations, structural calculations, electrical single-line diagrams, fire-retardant material certificates (Class 1), and health & safety documentation for DWTC/ADNEC approvals.

---

## 2. Institutional Event Staging & Graduation Ceremony Production

### Anchor Experience
EGS has served as the continuous event production and staging contractor for the Higher Colleges of Technology (HCT) for over 7 consecutive years.

### Technical Scope & Capacities
- **Heavy-Duty Certified Staging:** Modular staging systems capable of safely supporting large cohorts (500 to 5,000+ graduates), engineered procession ramps, ADA wheelchair ramps, and ceremonial acoustic underlays.
- **Ultra-Wide Curved LED Backdrops:** Modular LED screen configurations spanning 20 to 50+ metres with synchronized live video switching, graduate name calling cue engines, and custom motion graphics.
- **VIP & Royal Protocol Seating:** Luxurious bespoke VIP majlis setups, royal protocol furniture upholstery, executive podiums, and presidential media backdrops.
- **Acoustic Engineering & Lighting:** Tuned line-array sound reinforcement calibrated for vocal clarity in high-reverberation sports arenas and convention halls.

---

## 3. Retail Branding Rollouts & POSM Fabrication

### High-Volume Retail Capabilities
- **Free-Standing Display Units (FSDUs) & End-Caps:** High-load metal, acrylic, and wood retail display units for hypermarket FMCG distribution.
- **Supermarket Chiller Wraps:** Moisture-resistant vinyl wraps, magnetic perimeter trims, and branded illuminated header panels for commercial refrigeration aisles.
- **Overnight Fleet Deployment:** Dedicated logistics fleet with multi-crew supervisor teams capable of simultaneous overnight rollouts (e.g. 33 Carrefour hypermarkets across UAE completed in 6 hours between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM).

---

## 4. Commercial Fitouts & Architectural Signage

### Commercial Capabilities
- **3D Illuminated Channel Letters:** Front-lit, halo-backlit, edge-lit, and faux-neon signs using Samsung IP67 waterproof LED modules with 50,000+ hour operational lifespan.
- **Corporate Reception & Showroom Fitouts:** Custom reception desks, architectural wall cladding, acoustic slatted timber paneling, and brushed stainless steel logo plaques.
- **Municipal Permitting:** Complete Dubai Municipality and Civil Defence approval packages for exterior building signage, roof pylons, and projecting facade signs.

---

## 5. Exhibition Stand Pricing Guide in Dubai (2026 Reference)

| Stand Category | Typical Footprint | Estimated Cost Range (AED / sqm) | Included Features |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Tier 1: Economy / Shell Upgrade** | 9 – 18 sqm | AED 600 – AED 950 / sqm | Custom graphics, raised carpeted floor, lockable counter, LED spots |
| **Tier 2: Standard Custom Joinery** | 24 – 60 sqm | AED 1,000 – AED 1,750 / sqm | Bespoke wooden walls, 3D backlit logo, meeting lounge, product niches |
| **Tier 3: Premium Custom Flagship** | 60 – 150 sqm | AED 1,800 – AED 2,800 / sqm | High-pressure laminates, curved LED wall, hanging banner, VIP room |
| **Tier 4: Double-Decker Pavilion** | 100 – 400+ sqm | AED 2,800 – AED 4,500+ / sqm | Two-storey steel structure, internal staircase, luxury upper deck lounge |

*Note: Direct venue charges (electrical main supply connection, overhead rigging point rental, and organizer waste deposits) are billed directly by the venue (DWTC/ADNEC), with technical filings handled by EGS.*
